title: Electroporation of Vibrio natriegens (Weinstock et al. 2016, modified)
author: Benjamin Daniel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ptmdnk6
materials: Chill the culture on ice for 15 min
Adjust volume for a OD of 16

steps.title: Prepare fresh BHI+v2 culture
steps.instruction: Mix 10 mL Brain‑Heart Infusion (BHI) with v2 salts and inoculate with 1 % (v/v) of an overnight culture.

steps.title: Grow to mid‑log phase
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C with shaking until the optical density reaches 0.5.

steps.title: Harvest cells by cold centrifugation
steps.instruction: Place the culture on ice, then centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 20 min in a 4 °C refrigerated centrifuge.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend in electroporation buffer
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the pellet in 5–10 mL electroporation buffer (680 mM sucrose, 7 mM K₂HPO₄, pH 7) and fill the Falcon tube to the top.

steps.title: Wash cells three times
steps.instruction: Perform three successive washes: for each wash, centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 15 min at 4 °C, decant supernatant, and gently resuspend in 5 mL electroporation buffer. After the third wash, after the final spin, decant supernatant and resuspend the pellet in the residual buffer remaining in the tube.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze cells
steps.instruction: Dispense the competent cell suspension into chilled micro‑reaction tubes, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw and add plasmid
steps.instruction: Remove one aliquot from –80 °C, thaw on ice, add the plasmid DNA, and mix gently.

steps.title: Load cuvette
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell‑DNA mixture to a chilled electroporation cuvette.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate using a 1 mm cuvette at 700–900 V, 25 µF, and 200 Ω.

steps.title: Recover transformed cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the electroporated cells for 1 h at 37 °C in Brain‑Heart Infusion medium containing v2 salts.
